numeric_gate_limit: Edge ratios locate stress, but do not prove all visible spike pixels or anatomical failures.

confirmed_source_causes.defect: Abrupt proximal arm-to-torso classification at absolute X=.205
confirmed_source_causes.source_support: Preview2 still assigns one endpoint entirely to clavicle/upperarm and the adjacent endpoint entirely to spine_02/03.
confirmed_source_causes.repair_recommendation: Replace the hard arm branch with continuous proximal arm blend across absolute X approximately .17 to .30/.34, retaining adequate shoulder coverage. This is a tuning starting point and needs actual fixed-view deformation review.

confirmed_source_causes.defect: Posterior Y-based torso weighting leaks across sleeve and leather bracer
confirmed_source_causes.source_support: Dark-brown original UV pixels and actual rest coordinates identify forearm/bracer material. Spine_03 weight changes from near zero to .10-.23 across adjacent vertices as Y crosses .065+. This holds part of the forearm near the body while its neighbors follow the arm.
confirmed_source_causes.repair_recommendation: For absolute X>.34 use the fitted arm bones with full arm ownership regardless of Y/Z mantle factors. Apply cloak/torso exclusions only inside the proximal shoulder region and blend continuously there.

semantic_mask_limits.source_color: Original atlas has baked shading and neighboring islands. Olive edging can have R greater than G; a simple G>=.96*R gate does not identify every mantle pixel.
semantic_mask_limits.strong_arm_domain: Absolute X>.34 is supported by multiview donor evidence as sleeve/forearm/hand domain. The prominent mantle and hood are proximal. Use coordinate ownership first for distal arm skinning.
semantic_mask_limits.proximal_cape_domain: Within absolute X<.34, posterior Y>.09 is a useful cape candidate, but sleeve folds also reach this depth. Blend proximal ownership rather than a new hard color/Y threshold.
semantic_mask_limits.skin_and_neck: No edge with a rest-to-Idle ratio>4 in this diagnostic has source Z>1.3867. A visible face/neck tone patch should be inspected separately for corner material masks, normals or smaller deformation; do not infer a large geometric neck tear from the measured arm spikes.

review_proposal_not_validation: Recommendations describe a source repair; no changed weights or mesh were authored during this read-only diagnostic. Reinspect the repaired asset and exported poses before acceptance.
